text: Pilot deployments in 2024 and 2025 show major amendments completing from proposal to binding integration in under ten days, which the author presents as measured performance of tight coupling when participants have economic and reputational skin-in-the-game.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, The UDLC DAO Operationalizing a Continuously Evolving Universal Digital Law Codex Through Weighted (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5887242

isBasedOn.name: The UDLC DAO Operationalizing a Continuously Evolving Universal Digital Law Codex Through Weighted

abstract: The longest real-world examples to date (2024–2025 pilot deployments) show major amendments—from proposal to binding integration—completing in under ten days. This is not theoretical. It is the measured performance of the tight-coupling mechanism

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: 2024 to 2025 pilot deployments with expert participants holding stakes
